3a027832-2e4b-4706-aaed-5fc6ec5e59ad.content:
{{// 🩹 Chibi MiMo V2.6 Flash patch, for the model u/trashhaul caught writing slop the Pro patch couldn't stop, in about 80 tokens of text plus three plan and gate lines (about 99) where the full edition spends 235 and 104. Newcomers give a name and one reason for being here, and the rest of their card shows later through what they do. A run of 'not this, not that' before the real word shrinks to the real word, and narration sentences keep their own subject and verb and run five words or more. Characters react to what actually happened rather than to what kind of talk it is, and names, colours and values stay as first set. Chibi moved the Contrast, Flow and Introductions rules out of the system text into their plan and gate lines (the speech exceptions of Flow are left to the Codex's Chop rule). Switch 🔦 Flash Gate ON too, since it carries the rule against repeated demands, keep 🏷️ Logic Core Tags ON with native reasoning off, and try Temperature 0.8. MiMo V2.6 Pro uses 🩹 MiMo V2.6 Pro instead. Use one model patch at most.}}{{trim}}
Lulls: one card interest, by act or question to someone present.
Kept: names, colours, values, filled gaps stay as first set.
Repeats: counts, ages, images, paragraph layouts return only when the story changes them.
Reactions: answer what was said or done, its claims and stakes, by stance or act; dodge only when the card dodges.{{setvar::ariaPatchLines::3}}{{setvar::ariaPatchGate::- Negation runs: state the true thing once; cut every not/n't/never/no part beside it, runs and dash-led ones too, speech too, but refusals and denials stay.
- Flow: narration sentences carry their own subject and verb, five words or more; one person's small acts in a row share a sentence, two at most.
- Card details: a newcomer gives a name and one reason for being here; anyone's card details show one at a time through acts.}}

dc8b1acb-9a7e-5a43-b9aa-38e7b70662a3.content:
{{// 🧷 Chibi Character Hold, for quantised providers (NanoGPT, OpenRouter auto-routing and other nodes that serve trimmed weights), in about 54 tokens for its two lines where the full edition spends 82. u/Probablynotsocool found MiMo V2.6 Flash holding a layered card for ten or so turns on a quantised node, then flattening it: one strong beat, like a fight that wakes a survival instinct, becomes the whole character and the other traits fade. Every turn this puts the card back in front of the model. The plan gets a Layers line naming one card trait the mood fits and one it would bury, in the card's words, and both show up in the reply; the 🚪 Last-Mile Gate gets a matching line, so the reminder is the last rule the model reads. Works with any model, alongside its patch and the 🔦 Flash Gate. It costs nothing while it's off. On a full-precision provider you can usually leave it off.}}{{trim}}
